capacity_gross_kwh.notes: EV Database 2021 SR+ (Fremont, Panasonic 2170L NCA): 55.0 kWh nominal (evspecifications lists 55.4 kWh for the 2021 North American car). Assumes the Canadian 2021 SR+ is this Fremont NCA car; a CATL LFP SR+ (52.5 kWh usable) was built in Shanghai for other markets in the same period.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database 2021 SR+ (Fremont, Panasonic 2170L NCA): 51.0 kWh usable.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Panasonic SR+ pack family is 357 V nominal / 400 V architecture (EV Database 2019-2020 SR+); the 2021 pack is the same 2170 family.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2021 SR+). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.

dc_max_kw.notes: EV Database 2021 SR+: DC up to 170 kW; evspecifications 2021 SR+ 170 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: standard (non-Long-Range) battery gets 32 A (about 7.7 kW) per Tesla service manual wording; evspecifications lists 11.5 kW and EV Database 11 kW (3-phase, EU), which do not apply to single-phase North America.
